content: {"summary":"The June 2026 fraud‑scorer rollout increased per‑request CPU usage, causing CFS throttling on the fraud‑scorer pods. Throttling delayed fraud scores, so payments‑api fell back to static rules and emitted PAYAPI‑W0310 errors. Worker count, CPU limits and requests were unchanged, so the usual node‑size worker mismatch was not the trigger. The runbooks advise checking throttling metrics, GOMAXPROCS/WEB_CONCURRENCY settings, and adjusting the CPU limit or worker/thread count to match the quota.","likely_cause":"New fraud‑scorer code consumed more CPU per request, exceeding the container’s CFS quota and triggering throttling that delayed scores and produced PAYAPI‑W0310 errors.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The rollout caused a CPU spike on fraud‑scorer pods leading to throttling","evidence_ids":["INC-0172#0","INC-0172#1","RB-002#2"],"quote":"CPU on fraud-scorer-01 and fraud-scorer-02 both stepped up at about 00:11."},{"text":"Throttling delayed fraud scores, causing payments‑api to log PAYAPI‑W0310","evidence_ids":["INC-0172#0","RB-002#2"],"quote":"payments-api logs `PAYAPI-W0310` because the score did not come back in time."},{"text":"Worker count and CPU limits were unchanged, ruling out the usual throttling cause","evidence_ids":["INC-0172#1"],"quote":"Limit and request untouched by this release too."},{"text":"Docs recommend inspecting throttling metrics, GOMAXPROCS/WEB_CONCURRENCY, and adjusting CPU limit or worker count","evidence_ids":["RB-002#0","RB-002#1","RB-002#2","RB-002#3"],"quote":"raise the CPU limit for the affected Deployment ... or set the thread or worker count"}],"next_checks":["Check the \"Container CPU\" panel in Grafana with throttling mode enabled and note `container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total`/`container_cpu_cfs_periods_total` ratios","Run `kubectl exec <pod> -- cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat` twice and compare `nr_throttled` and `throttled_usec` growth","Verify GOMAXPROCS (Go) and WEB_CONCURRENCY (Python) values inside the pods match the container CPU limit","Profile a single worker of the new fraud‑scorer build against the previous version under identical load to locate extra CPU usage","Consider raising the CPU limit or reducing thread/worker count per RB‑002 guidance","Add a throttling alert to the service monitoring if not already present"]}
